title: CLTR Cutover CutoverCandidate record
description: Phase 136N, Implementation Group 4. Shape-only wire contract for a CutoverCandidate companion record (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.22). A CutoverCandidate document proposes a specific, bounded cutover attempt; it never itself proves eligibility, human authorization, certification, CAS success, publication success, cutover completion, or current authority (Sec.1, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Tier 2 (_extensions only, Sec.14). authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden (Sec.9's 12-file list includes cutover_candidate) at every state, including 'certified' (Sec.22). IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY DISCLOSURE (documented, not silently resolved): Sec.22's frozen field table lists exactly three record-specific fields -- stage2_generation_reference, cas_expectation, state -- and does NOT include direct top-level request_reference / readiness_reference / authorization_reference / source_authority_reference / target_epoch_reference fields of the kind an earlier, more expansive phase-prompt draft anticipated. Per governing instruction to follow the primary frozen contract over prompt-suggested fields, this schema implements exactly Sec.22's three fields plus the universal envelope; it does NOT add the extra binding fields. Binding-chain evidence is instead carried indirectly through cas_expectation's own required sub-fields (expected_request_reference, expected_authority_epoch, expected_authoritative_generation, expected_certification_reference) -- readiness_reference and authorization_reference binding is NOT present anywhere on this record family in v1.0 (disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136N-6, DEFERRED: a possible future minor-version field, not added here to avoid inventing an unfrozen requirement).

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the CutoverCandidate schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

created_at.description: Always present. Never used to establish record identity or ordering across documents.

migration_epoch.description: Always present. Every companion record binds to exactly one migration epoch (Sec.7.2, CSCH-INV-1). cutover_candidate is not in the phase_id-required or transition_id-required family lists (Sec.7.2), so neither field is declared here.

stage2_generation_reference.description: Always present (Sec.22). Points at the existing, already-implemented Stage 2 rehearsal generation -- not redefined by this contract. Sec.22's field table types this 'record_reference' literally; 'generation' is not itself one of the 16 record_family enum values (shared/enums.schema.json), so no record_family const restriction is applied here -- this reference's family cannot be locally closed the way in-package references are (disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136N-7: cross-family substitution protection for this one field is a Layer 4 responsibility, not locally enforceable given the frozen record_family vocabulary's scope).

cas_expectation.description: Always present (Sec.22). Every expected-state field within this embedded component is itself unconditionally required (Sec.24) -- no wildcard-on-missing-value hazard is structurally possible.

state.description: Always present. Record-local CandidateState (Sec.8.8, 6 values). No Sec.16 conditional row exists for cutover_candidate state branches; reaching 'certified' here is a local status label only and never itself proves certification, publication, or cutover occurred (Layer 4/6).

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden on this record at every state including 'certified' (Sec.9's 12-file list, Sec.22); is_authoritative remains const false per the shared definition regardless.

_extensions.description: Conditionally present: the single reserved Tier 2 extension key (Sec.14). String-valued map only, no nested arbitrary structure. Forward-compatible annotation only; never authority-bearing, never interpreted as candidate eligibility.
